name: Survey Pulse paired authoring trial
specificationOrigin: Same feature set from the prior Copperbench trial, available before native authoring

features.scanShape: inclusive axis-aligned cube; loaded positions only
features.orePolicy: registry path ends with _ore or equals ancient_debris
features.feedback: count and nearest relative coordinates; no-ore message
features.particle: END_ROD, 12 particles at the nearest block

acceptanceLayers.packaged: real remapped JAR with entrypoint, item model, language and recipe
acceptanceLayers.pureLogic: 8 executable native scanner assertions; not in-game tests
acceptanceLayers.preservation: external helper edit hash survives display-name resource edit and build
acceptanceLayers.gameplay: not claimed without actual Minecraft interaction evidence

matchedBuilds.runner: same JDK 21, Gradle 9.7.0 wrapper, --no-daemon; existing user dependency cache
matchedBuilds.limits: two samples per project; scaffold and project-cache contents differ; not a statistical productivity benchmark
